fixes.what: In `.cta--poster`, change `padding-block:clamp(96px,16vh,180px)` to `padding-block:clamp(64px,10vh,112px)` and reduce `.cta__wordmark` bottom margin to `clamp(20px,3.5vh,36px)`
fixes.why: On desktop (shot 4), the excessive top padding pushes `.cta__wordmark` above the viewport fold when scrolled to the poster section, cutting off the top of the poster composition.

fixes.what: On `.leaf-band`, add `margin-top:clamp(32px,6vh,64px)` and change `background:var(--cream)` to `background:var(--brown)` while keeping the top mask
fixes.why: The static leaf band above the brown poster CTA is currently invisible in scroll transitions because it blends directly into the ground/footer band without visual separation above the poster border.

fixes.what: Change `.hero__shade` box-shadow opacity from `rgba(67,38,23,.68)` to `rgba(67,38,23,.76)` and add a subtle bottom gradient inside `.hero__window` (`background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(67,38,23,.45) 0%,transparent 35%)`)
fixes.why: In the hero (shot 0), the bright white roses and table highlights inside the bottom of the arch window compete with the cream `ANAR EVENTS` wordmark, slightly reducing contrast on the inner letters.

fixes.what: Update `--red:#9E1B32` to `--red:#B81428` (or closer to the brand book's vibrant `#D10C0C` while maintaining AA contrast on `#F0E6D5`)
fixes.why: The current `--red` (`#9E1B32`) reads as a muted burgundy/maroon rather than the vibrant pomegranate Anar red specified in the brand book (`#D10C0C`) and used in the header SVG wordmark.

Vertically centering the rotated titles (`NIKAH`, `MEHNDI & SANGEET`, `RECEPTION & WALIMA`) inside the collapsed accordion strips looks much more balanced and editorial than pinning them near the bottom edge.

fixes.what: Change `.field input,.field textarea,.field select` border from `1px solid var(--brown)` to `1px solid rgba(67,38,23,.45)` and add `background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)`
fixes.why: Full-strength `1px solid #432617` boxes on all form inputs look slightly harsh and utilitarian against the soft editorial cream palette; softening the border and warming the fill elevates the form.
